name: Puget Sound NxNxN 2019
information:
This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the WCA regulations. Please refer to the "[Competitor Responsibilities](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PugetSoundNxNxN2019#10659-competitor-responsibilities)" tab.

For more information about cubing in the Pacific Northwest, check out our [new website!](https://www.pnwcubing.com)
